newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos arrives late after punctuality campaign launch.
newsitem.headline: Ramos arrives late after punctuality campaign launch.

text.p: President Fidel Ramos, fresh from declaring a national punctuality week in the relaxed tropical Philippines, promptly turned up an hour late for an appointment, his aides said on Wednesday.
Ramos apologised to Red Cross officials for being late when he spoke at an anniversary celebration on Monday, blaming Tiger Woods's win at the U.S. Masters golf tournament.
Aides told reporters the 69-year-old Ramos had risen at 4 a.m. that day to watch the golf on television which Woods won by a record 12 strokes.
He then went back to bed.
"My aide gave me a frantic call on the telephone because apparently I overslept," Ramos said.
Ramos declared April 12 to 18 national punctuality week to remind Filipinos they had to quit the habit of being late if the country had any chance of becoming globally competitive.
